description: Explores advanced statistical learning theory, kernel methods, ensemble architectures, probabilistic graphical models, and modern dimensionality reduction algorithms.
learning_objectives: Analyze statistical learning theory, PAC learnability, VC-dimension, and generalization bounds.
Master kernel methods, Support Vector Machines, and Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS).
Design advanced ensemble models including AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, and Stacking.
Understand probabilistic graphical models, Bayesian networks, and non-linear manifold learning.
outline: Statistical Learning Theory: PAC learning framework, VC-dimension, Rademacher complexity, generalization error bounds, bias-variance tradeoff.
Kernel Methods & Advanced SVMs: Mercer's theorem, RKHS, Support Vector Regression, Kernel Ridge Regression.
Ensemble Learning: Bagging, Random Forests, Boosting algorithms (AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost), Stacking.
Probabilistic Graphical Models: Bayesian networks, Markov Random Fields (MRFs), inference algorithms (Variable Elimination, Belief Propagation), sampling methods (MCMC, Gibbs sampling).
Semi-Supervised & Active Learning: Self-training, co-training, graph-based semi-supervised learning, query strategies for active learning.
Dimensionality Reduction & Manifold Learning: t-SNE, UMAP, Isomap, Locally Linear Embedding (LLE), Autoencoders.
